description: A ground-level photograph of a large, open landscape showing a recently clear-cut forest area. The foreground and mid-ground are dominated by disturbed, bare earth, scattered woody debris (branches, stumps), and faint parallel rows indicating either new sapling plantings or prepared soil for regeneration. A single, tall, thin, and apparently dead or sparsely foliated tree stands prominently in the central-right foreground. In the far background, a dense treeline or forest edge is visible under a cloudy, overcast sky. This scene is consistent with "Transitional woodland and scrub," representing either woodland degradation or early stages of forest regeneration/recolonization, where young individuals are less than 5 metres in height.
